Funde con negro el borde de abajo de la: Fades the bottom edge of the art into black. Untouched, the frame's (12 mm with a 7 mm extension on extended). At 0 mm, no fade. The extension lets the art continue below its window as it fades out: it shows wherever the frame doesn't cover it (on extended, beside and below the box).
Cuánto más alta (en positivo, crece haci: How much taller (positive: it grows upwards and the art gets shorter) or shorter (negative: the text shrinks if needed). At 0, as the frame comes. The Balatro frame doesn't change.
Dinámica: la caja crece o se encoge segú: Dynamic: the box grows or shrinks with the text, so cards with little text stay uncluttered. Fixed: always the frame's maximum height. By frame: whatever each frame decides (built-in Classic and Extended are fixed).

Fichas: {num} {rarity} {original} {set}: Tokens: {num} {rarity} {original} {set} {lang} {artist} {credit} {universe} {year} {brush} {star}. A tab separates columns; a new line, rows; whatever follows {>} goes on the right. Empty means the default one. If it doesn't use {universe}, {year} or {credit}, they go on the right of the last line on their own.
